trips.label: Talgar
trips.route_note: Take a marshrutka (minibus) from Almaty's Sayran bus station toward Talgar, then a taxi or shared taxi up the valley road to the Turgen Gorge trailhead for the last few kilometres.
trips.tour_query: Turgen Gorge day trip from Almaty
trips.why: The 31 km road trip is short, but transit needs a marshrutka plus a last-mile shared taxi, so a taxi is simpler and clearly better.
know: Go in late spring to autumn; winter snow can make the valley road and trailhead difficult.
Taxi fare is 3600 KZT, so agree on the price before you set off.
Trailhead is for Turgen Gorge; plan for hiking and bring water and warm layers.
